title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales agent as the agentic home for sellers
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, licensing statements and existing administrator paths are supported. It distinguishes the planned home from today's embedded Sales agent and appropriately leaves the home's default, dedicated controls and feature-specific charges open.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Sales agent home that sellers can land in instead of a traditional Dynamics 365 Sales dashboard.
claims.quote: When sellers open Dynamics 365 Sales, they can land in Sales agent: an agentic home for all sales AI instead of a traditional dashboard.

claims.claim: The planned home brings agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together through structured workflows.
claims.quote: Structured workflows in Sales agent bring agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together

claims.claim: Sellers will be able to review prioritised recommendations and next steps from their agents in the planned home.
claims.quote: From this home, sellers can review prioritized recommendations and next steps from their agents

claims.claim: The roadmap includes preparation for upcoming customer meetings in the planned home.
claims.quote: prepare for upcoming customer meetings

claims.claim: The planned home includes reviewing past meetings when the required meeting information is available.
claims.quote: review past meetings when the required meeting information is available.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes moving from an insight to the next action in the selling workflow.
claims.quote: Sellers can understand the context behind their work and move from an insight to the next action in their selling workflow.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics, including whether the home replaces every seller's opening dashboard, are not published.

claims.claim: Sales agent's Microsoft Graph grounding includes email and meeting context.

claims.claim: The cited usage page describes embedded Sales agent access in Dynamics 365 as preview.
claims.quote: The following capabilities are in preview: Sales agent is also accessible in Microsoft 365 Copilot within Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Dynamics 365.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: The current embedded Dynamics 365 experience does not provide the meeting preparation experience described on the usage page.
claims.quote: The meeting experience is only available in the full-screen mode of Sales agent chat experience. It's not available when using Microsoft 365 Copilot in Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: Sales agent in Dynamics 365 requires Microsoft 365 Copilot to be enabled for the environment and app module.
claims.quote: The Sales agent is available in Dynamics 365 only when Microsoft 365 Copilot is enabled for the environment and app module.

claims.claim: Automatic installation alone does not make Sales agent available in Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: Automatic installation alone doesn't make the Sales agent available in Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: Sales agent's available CRM tables are configured in its administrator settings.
claims.quote: The Sales agent accesses CRM information based on the CRM entities configured in Sales agent admin settings. In Dynamics 365, these entities are tables.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Sales agent has access to all columns in entities added to its configured list.
claims.quote: Sales agent will have access to all columns in the added entities (tables in Dynamics 365 or objects in Salesforce).

claims.claim: Sales agent only surfaces information the user has permission to access.
claims.quote: Sales agent only surfaces information you have permission to access. Results depend on the data available in your Microsoft 365 environment.

claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't grant access to CRM data

claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't grant access to CRM data and don't override licensing, environment, or security requirements.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Dynamics 365 administrator settings require System Administrator or System Customizer, with additional privileges potentially needed for custom security roles.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365: You must have the System Administrator or System Customizer role. If you're using a custom security role, you might need more privileges to use the Sales agent.

claims.claim: The Dynamics 365 access control is reached in Microsoft Teams through Sales > Settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent > Dynamics 365.

claims.quote: In the navigation pane, go to Copilot > Settings. Under Power Apps, expand Chat Agent and choose Microsoft Copilot. Select an environment group or an environment name, then select Edit Setting.
